commit_message:
[Util] Preserve scf.forall shared output traversal

The RegionBranchOpInterface entry mapping for scf.forall does not include shared outputs, even though each output ties an operand, block argument, and result. Follow these ties in both traversal directions and avoid indexing empty entry operand ranges.

Add coverage for preserving an explicit affinity across a region boundary when the enclosing default affinity differs.

Tests:
- ctest --test-dir build/iree-24775-cmake -R '^iree/compiler/Dialect/Stream/Transforms/test/annotate_affinities\.mlir\.test$' --output-on-failure
- ctest --test-dir build/iree-24775-cmake -R '^iree/compiler/Dialect/Stream/Transforms/test/clone_to_consumers\.mlir\.test$' --output-on-failure

commit_message:
[StableHLO] Legalize composite ops to calls in the input pipeline (#24777)

The StableHLO input conversion pipeline had no handling for
`stablehlo.composite`, so any composite reaching the conversion to
Linalg failed with:
```
  error: failed to legalize operation 'stablehlo.composite' that was explicitly marked illegal
```

JAX emits composites for some CHLO operations, e.g.
```
  %0 = stablehlo.composite "chlo.acos" %arg0
      {decomposition = @chlo.acos.impl, version = 1 : i32}
      : (tensor<8x32xf32>) -> tensor<8x32xf32>
```
which made such models uncompilable.

Run `stablehlo-legalize-composite-to-call` early in the pipeline, right
after deserialization. It replaces each composite with a call to the
function holding its decomposition, which the inliner later in the
pipeline folds away, so the remaining conversions only ever see the
decomposed form. The pass is given an explicit empty exception list to
document where composites that should be preserved as a unit can be
opted out.

Signed-off-by: Paul Stark <paul.stark@cdprojektred.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit_message:
[StableHLO] Legalize composite ops to calls in the input pipeline (#24777)

The StableHLO input conversion pipeline had no handling for
`stablehlo.composite`, so any composite reaching the conversion to
Linalg failed with:
```
  error: failed to legalize operation 'stablehlo.composite' that was explicitly marked illegal
```

JAX emits composites for some CHLO operations, e.g.
```
  %0 = stablehlo.composite "chlo.acos" %arg0
      {decomposition = @chlo.acos.impl, version = 1 : i32}
      : (tensor<8x32xf32>) -> tensor<8x32xf32>
```
which made such models uncompilable.

Run `stablehlo-legalize-composite-to-call` early in the pipeline, right
after deserialization. It replaces each composite with a call to the
function holding its decomposition, which the inliner later in the
pipeline folds away, so the remaining conversions only ever see the
decomposed form. The pass is given an explicit empty exception list to
document where composites that should be preserved as a unit can be
opted out.

Signed-off-by: Paul Stark <paul.stark@cdprojektred.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>

commit_message:
[StableHLO] Legalize composite ops to calls in the input pipeline (#24777)

The StableHLO input conversion pipeline had no handling for
`stablehlo.composite`, so any composite reaching the conversion to
Linalg failed with:
```
  error: failed to legalize operation 'stablehlo.composite' that was explicitly marked illegal
```

JAX emits composites for some CHLO operations, e.g.
```
  %0 = stablehlo.composite "chlo.acos" %arg0
      {decomposition = @chlo.acos.impl, version = 1 : i32}
      : (tensor<8x32xf32>) -> tensor<8x32xf32>
```
which made such models uncompilable.

Run `stablehlo-legalize-composite-to-call` early in the pipeline, right
after deserialization. It replaces each composite with a call to the
function holding its decomposition, which the inliner later in the
pipeline folds away, so the remaining conversions only ever see the
decomposed form. The pass is given an explicit empty exception list to
document where composites that should be preserved as a unit can be
opted out.

Signed-off-by: Paul Stark <paul.stark@cdprojektred.com>
Co-authored-by: Claude Opus 5 (1M context) <noreply@anthropic.com>
name: linux-aarch64 :: Build main-dist-linux Package

commit_message:
Add disabled checks for scf.while result producer-affinity union

The producer affinity of the scf.while single result in
@scf_while_return_second_loop_carried is currently over-approximated as the
union of both loop-carried affinities ([dev_a, dev_c]) rather than just
[dev_c], and the consuming transfer's operand affinity inherits that union.

Record the expected post-fix affinities as FileCheck COM: (comment) directives
next to the affected ops so they are documented and can be re-enabled by
dropping the COM: prefix once the producer-side over-approximation is resolved.
The comments reference the tracking issue.

Signed-off-by: Paul Stark <paul.stark@cdprojektred.com>

Add disabled checks for scf.while result producer-affinity union

The producer affinity of the scf.while single result in
@scf_while_return_second_loop_carried is currently over-approximated as the
union of both loop-carried affinities ([dev_a, dev_c]) rather than just
[dev_c], and the consuming transfer's operand affinity inherits that union.

Record the expected post-fix affinities as FileCheck COM: (comment) directives
next to the affected ops so they are documented and can be re-enabled by
dropping the COM: prefix once the producer-side over-approximation is resolved.
The comments reference the tracking issue.

Signed-off-by: Paul Stark <paul.stark@cdprojektred.com>

commit_message:
[Codegen][LLVMCPU] Split loadProcessorData: hoist only the alloca (#24744)

35b2070 (#24749) fixed unbounded stack growth by moving the whole
loadProcessorData CPU-feature patch buffer construction to the function entry
block. But that also hoisted the feature-bit or/store away from the ukernel
call, and once the ukernel inlines, LLVM can no longer store-to-load forward the
forced feature bits into the ukernel's runtime feature check across the
enclosing loop, so the mmt4d/pack tile-func select never devirtualizes and the
microkernel is left out-of-line.

Split the two concerns: reserve only the alloca (the stack slot, the actual
cause of #24744) in the entry block, but keep the feature-bit patch at the call
site. The stores re-run per iteration but allocate no stack, so the stack stays
bounded while the forced bits remain adjacent to the (inlined) load and fold as
before, restoring devirtualization.

Signed-off-by: Ege Beysel <beyselege@gmail.com>

commit_message:
[LLVMCPU][ukernel] Drop the LLVMCPU ukernel feature-strip (keep ROCm's)

Stripping target-cpu/tune-cpu/target-features off the linked LLVMCPU ukernel
bitcode is unsafeas is: a feature-specific tile variant that survives behind the
runtime cpu-feature select still reaches codegen, and once stripped its
intrinsics (e.g. the x86 pack AVX2 gather) become unlegalizable on a lower
target and crash the backend (#24755). Remove the strip from loadUKernelBitcode;
the proper fix will land separately on top of this.

The LLVMCPU ukernel-inlining lit test moves with the fix.

Signed-off-by: Ege Beysel <beyselege@gmail.com>

commit_message:
[Preprocessing] Skip convs with extra operands in convert-conv-to-channels-last

transposeConvLikeLinalgOp reads the image, filter and output as operands
0, 1 and 2, and the builders it hands off to rebuild the op with exactly
two inputs and one init. A quantized convolution such as
linalg.conv_2d_nchw_fchw_q has ins(image, filter, input_zp, filter_zp)
and outs(output), so operand 2 is an i32 zero point rather than the
output tensor. Its indexing map has no results, the pack of the output
is a no-op, and the rebuilt linalg.generic is created with an i32 init,
which fails verification with

  'linalg.generic' op operand #2 must be variadic of shaped of any
  non-token type values, but got 'i32'

Bail out when the op does not have the two inputs and one init the
rewrite knows how to reconstruct.

ConvertGenericFilterToFhwc in ConvertConvFilterToChannelsLast.cpp
rebuilds the op the same way and looks to need the same guard. That is
left out here to keep this change to the reproducer in the issue.

Fixes #24774

Add disabled checks for scf.while result producer-affinity union

The producer affinity of the scf.while single result in
@scf_while_return_second_loop_carried is currently over-approximated as the
union of both loop-carried affinities ([dev_a, dev_c]) rather than just
[dev_c], and the consuming transfer's operand affinity inherits that union.

Record the expected post-fix affinities as FileCheck COM: (comment) directives
next to the affected ops so they are documented and can be re-enabled by
dropping the COM: prefix once the producer-side over-approximation is resolved.
The comments reference the tracking issue.
